---
title: "Ensemble models (flexible benchmark for discrimination)"
output: html_document
params:
  cores: 1
---

Reproduces **Figure 1** (jaundice onset within 30 days), **Figure S2** (within 14 days), **Figure S3** (jaundice onset within 30 days, confirmed infection based on PCR instead of ELISA),and **Figure S5** (children under 14, South Sudan), and the AUCs quoted in the Results.

**Runtime:** each model refits the ensemble once per patient. With `cores = 1` this
takes several hours (most of it Bangladesh, n = 1,625). To run faster, knit with
`rmarkdown::render("02_ensemble_models.Rmd", params = list(cores = 8))`; results then
differ slightly in the third decimal place from the sequential run (see `R/ensemble.R`).
When running in parallel, start R with `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1` and `VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1`
so each worker uses one thread; otherwise the workers compete for cores.

Not reproduced here: Figure S4 (Bangladesh symptoms on the day of admission), because
that variable is not in the analytic dataset.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
library(cowplot)
source(here("R", "data.R"))
source(here("R", "ensemble.R"))

# Parallel workers only get reproducible random-number streams with this generator.
# Results then depend on `cores`, so report it alongside the AUCs.
if (params$cores > 1) RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")

ssd <- load_ssd() %>% select(-all_of(SSD_RARE_SYMPTOMS))                       # IgM
ssd_pcr <- load_ssd(outcome = "pcr") %>% select(-all_of(SSD_RARE_SYMPTOMS))    # PCR
ssd_children <- load_ssd(children = TRUE) %>% select(-all_of(SSD_RARE_SYMPTOMS))
bd <- load_bd()

# AUC direction is fixed (higher prediction = HEV positive): a model that ranks
# patients backwards must get AUC 0, not 1.
stopifnot(auc_summary(c(0, 0, 1, 1), c(0.9, 0.8, 0.2, 0.1), "check", boot.n = 10)$auc$auc == 0)
```

## South Sudan

```{r ssd}
set.seed(1234)
ssd_30 <- run_ensembles(ssd, SSD_DEMOGRAPHICS, "South Sudan", "IgM", "<=30 days", params$cores)
ssd_30_pcr <- run_ensembles(ssd_pcr, SSD_DEMOGRAPHICS, "South Sudan", "PCR", "<=30 days", params$cores)
ssd_14 <- run_ensembles(filter(ssd, days_since_ajs_baseline <= 14), SSD_DEMOGRAPHICS,
                        "South Sudan", "IgM", "<=14 days", params$cores)

```

## Bangladesh

```{r bd}
set.seed(12345)
bd_30 <- run_ensembles(bd, BD_DEMOGRAPHICS, "Bangladesh", "IgM", "<=30 days", params$cores)
bd_14 <- run_ensembles(filter(bd, days_since_ajs <= 14), BD_DEMOGRAPHICS,
                       "Bangladesh", "IgM", "<=14 days", params$cores)
```

## Children under 14 (South Sudan)

```{r children}
set.seed(1234)
ssd_kids <- run_ensembles(ssd_children, SSD_DEMOGRAPHICS, "South Sudan children", "IgM", "<=30 days",
                          params$cores)
```

## AUCs

```{r auc}
runs <- list(ssd_30, bd_30, ssd_14, bd_14, ssd_30_pcr, ssd_kids)
aucs <- bind_rows(lapply(runs, `[[`, "auc"))
key <- do.call(paste, c(aucs[c("population", "reference_test", "time_window", "predictor_set")], sep = "|"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(key))
aucs %>% mutate(across(c(auc, lower, upper), ~ round(., 2)))

# Full-precision cache for audit/audit.R (checks the AUCs quoted in the paper
# without refitting), the held-out predictions behind every AUC, and run metadata.
# Regenerate the figures and the manuscript AUCs from this same run.
write.csv(aucs, here("audit", "ensemble_aucs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(lapply(runs, `[[`, "pred")), here("audit", "ensemble_predictions.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
git_commit <- tryCatch(system2("git", c("-C", here(), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE),
                       error = function(e) NA_character_)
data_md5 <- tools::md5sum(here(c("dat_ssd_adjusted.rds", "dat_ssd_adjusted_children.rds",
                                 "dat_bd_adjusted.rds")))
writeLines(c(
  paste("run_date:", format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE)),
  paste("git_commit:", git_commit),
  paste("seeds: South Sudan 1234, Bangladesh 12345, children 1234"),
  paste("rng_kind:", paste(RNGkind(), collapse = ", ")),
  paste("cores:", params$cores),
  paste("data_md5:", basename(names(data_md5)), unname(data_md5)),
  "", capture.output(sessionInfo())
), here("audit", "ensemble_run_info.txt"))
```

## Figures

```{r figures, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
# Figure 1
plot_grid(plot_roc(ssd_30$roc, "red", "A"), plot_roc(bd_30$roc, "orange", "B"))
# Figure S2
plot_grid(plot_roc(ssd_14$roc, "red", "A"), plot_roc(bd_14$roc, "orange", "B"))
# Figure S3 (reference test: PCR)
plot_roc(ssd_30_pcr$roc, "red")
# Figure S5
plot_roc(ssd_kids$roc, "red")
```
